newsitem.title: SPAIN: Sogecable says in digital TV deal with DirecTV.
newsitem.headline: Sogecable says in digital TV deal with DirecTV.

text.p: Spanish pay TV giant Sogecable has reached an agreement to create a joint digital TV platform in Spain with DirecTV, a spokesman for 25-percent stakeholder and manager Promotora de Informaciones SA (PRISA) confirmed.
U.S. -based Daily Variety newspaper reported the deal today between Sogecable and DirecTV, a unit of General Motors Corp's Hughes Electronics Corp subsidiary.
Other major shareholders in Sogecable are France's Canal Plus SA, with a 25 percent stake, and Banco Bilbao Vizcaya and Grupo March each with a 15.79 stake.
Sogecable will also work with Galaxy Latin America, which supplies digital telvision services by satellite to Latin America, the spokesman told Reuters in response to a query.
